tests.stressSelectionRule: final product partition only; actual complete pinned-condition q-price path since admission; first maximum divided by first preceding minimum >=10, current/peak<=0.8; current actual complete and every condition has a native quote before the 30-day blackout

pokemon.partitionRule: sha256(dynamic-card-index-validation-v1:brand:productId) first byte parity; development even, final validation odd
pokemon.independenceMeaning: development and final held-out target product IDs are disjoint; shared archived market context and retrospective fits, not external future validation
pokemon.tailThresholdMeaning: product sum(initialQuantity * current actual price) divided by sum(initialQuantity * actual admission-window entryPrice); equal-amount-fixed initial sum is one monetary unit
